descriptions.w3d_set_s8_from_float_801ed690: Converts the given float to a signed byte (quantized store) and passes it to a setter on the target through a pointer to member function.
descriptions.w3d_set_u16_from_float_801ed6f4: Converts the given float to an unsigned 16-bit value (quantized store) and passes it to a setter through a pointer to member function.
descriptions.w3d_set_s16_from_float_801ed758: Converts the given float to a signed 16-bit value (quantized store) and passes it to a setter through a pointer to member function.
descriptions.w3d_floats_to_u8_8020e6c0: Converts count floats to u8 values with the quantized store (GQR), advancing both arrays; returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_u8_to_floats_8020e700: Converts count u8 values to floats with the quantized load (GQR), advancing both arrays; returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_floats_to_u16_8020e740: Converts count floats to u16 values with the quantized store (GQR), advancing both arrays; returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_u16_to_floats_8020e780: Converts count u16 values to floats with the quantized load (GQR), advancing both arrays; returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_floats_to_s8_8020e88c: Converts count floats to s8 values with the quantized store (GQR), advancing both arrays; returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_s8_to_floats_8020e8cc: Converts count s8 values to floats with the quantized load (GQR), advancing both arrays; returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_floats_to_s16_8020e90c: Converts count floats to s16 values with the quantized store (GQR), advancing both arrays; returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_s16_to_floats_8020e94c: Converts count s16 values to floats with the quantized load (GQR), advancing both arrays; returns zero.
descriptions.w3d_get_field_as_u8_802bfc48: Returns the float field at a fixed offset converted to an unsigned byte (quantized store).
